snippet.title: Deck of Harvest-Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Game Title: Deck of Harvest
Hi everyone! Here is GameFarmer Studio and the first indie game "Deck of Harvest", which is porduced with Pone Games. Welcome to add this game to your Wishlist!
Steam Page:https://store.steampowered.com/app/3668640/Deck_of_Harvest
"Deck of Harvest" is a strategy game that combines deck building with farm management.  In a world with four-season cycles, to get through the heat and cold, you need to carefully plan your farmland, build a perfect deck of cards, maximize your harvest, and strive to reach the production target of each season. 

Discord:https://discord.gg/tk35qhkdYr
